inputSummary.basemap: pinned real Innsbruck vector roads/buildings/land/water/place labels, identical local fixture and MapLibre6.14 SDK
limitations: Whole native map WebGL context measured including basemap and business; compositor GPU is separate.
Native frame/rAF callback intervals are not physical monitor FPS; browser tracing presentation must be independently validated.
Shared production stream parser/pack/detector, synthetic uniform point workload on a real geographic city map. Production Baidu mixed-geometry validation is separate.
Native MapLibre GeoJSON source waits source/tile idle; others actual geometry draw/upload ACK; gates explicitly differ.
Phase CPU spans nest/overlap and workers run concurrently; do not sum to end-to-end wall duration.
Native worker parse synchronous prefixes are partial, not total async CPU; null fields retain missing coverage.
Single machine, frequency/OS/background load uncontrolled; instrumentation affects all arms. This derived report is public under explicit user authorization.
